info.name: CRM Company Creation - E2E Positive & Negative
info.description: Postman collection derived from BDD scenarios: 'End-to-End Positive Company Creation Flow' and 'End-to-End Negative Company Validation Flow'. Endpoint, payload fields, and response shape captured directly from the real OS CRM API (api.crm.osllc.us) via browser DevTools Network tab.

item.name: Create Company - Valid Data (Nova Tech Solutions)

request.description:
Corresponds to: entering Company Information (Name, Industry, Company Type, Website, Phone), proceeding through Billing Information step, and submitting to create the company.

NOTE: industryId 18 and companyTypeId 1 were captured from a live test ('Information Technology' / a sample type) in this CRM instance's dropdowns. If your instance's IDs differ for 'Information Technology and Services' / 'Private', look them up via the industry/company-type list endpoints (seen in your Network tab as 'industry?query=all' and 'company-type?query=all') and update these values.
